=== vs_storage msl vertex 0 - 0
entrypoint: main0
#pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wmissing-prototypes"

#include <metal_stdlib>
#include <simd/simd.h>

using namespace metal;

// Implementation of signed integer mod accurate to SPIR-V specification
template<typename Tx, typename Ty>
inline Tx spvSMod(Tx x, Ty y)
{
    Tx remainder = x - y * (x / y);
    return select(Tx(remainder + y), remainder, remainder == 0 || (x >= 0) == (y >= 0));
}

    float4 out_color [[user(locn0)]];
    uint out_flags [[user(locn1)]];
    float2 out_uv [[user(locn2)]];
    float4 gl_Position [[position]];
    float gl_PointSize [[point_size]];
};

vertex main0_out main0(constant Camera& camera [[buffer(0)]], const device Sprites& _17 [[buffer(1)]], texture2d<float> heightmap [[texture(0)]], sampler heightmapSmplr [[sampler(0)]], uint gl_InstanceIndex [[instance_id]], uint gl_VertexIndex [[vertex_id]])
{
    main0_out out = {};
    Sprite s;
    s.position = _17.sprites[int(gl_InstanceIndex)].position;
    s.size = _17.sprites[int(gl_InstanceIndex)].size;
    s.color = _17.sprites[int(gl_InstanceIndex)].color;
    s.flags = _17.sprites[int(gl_InstanceIndex)].flags;
    s.rotation = _17.sprites[int(gl_InstanceIndex)].rotation;
    float2 corner = camera.corners[spvSMod(int(gl_VertexIndex), 4)].xy;
    float c = cos(s.rotation);
    float n = sin(s.rotation);
    float2 p = (float2((corner.x * c) - (corner.y * n), (corner.x * n) + (corner.y * c)) * s.size) + s.position;
    float h = heightmap.sample(heightmapSmplr, (p * 0.00999999977648258209228515625), level(0.0)).x;
    if (camera.mode == 1)
    {
        h *= 2.0;
    }
    else
    {
        if (camera.mode > 1)
        {
            h = -h;
        }
    }
    out.out_color = s.color;
    out.out_flags = s.flags | uint(int(gl_VertexIndex) << 16);
    out.out_uv = (corner * 0.5) + float2(0.5);
    out.gl_Position = camera.view_projection * float4(p, h, 1.0);
    out.gl_PointSize = 1.0;
    return out;
}

=== vs_storage hlsl vertex 60 - 0
entrypoint: main
struct Sprite
{
    float2 position;
    float2 size;
    float4 color;
    uint flags;
    float rotation;
};

ByteAddressBuffer _17 : register(t1, space0);
cbuffer Camera : register(b0, space1)
{
    row_major float4x4 camera_view_projection : packoffset(c0);
    float4 camera_corners[4] : packoffset(c4);
    int camera_mode : packoffset(c8);
};

Texture2D<float4> heightmap : register(t0, space0);
SamplerState _heightmap_sampler : register(s0, space0);

static float4 gl_Position;
static float gl_PointSize;
static int gl_VertexIndex;
static int gl_InstanceIndex;
static float4 out_color;
static uint out_flags;
static float2 out_uv;

struct SPIRV_Cross_Input
{
    uint gl_VertexIndex : SV_VertexID;
    uint gl_InstanceIndex : SV_InstanceID;
};

struct SPIRV_Cross_Output
{
    float4 out_color : TEXCOORD0;
    nointerpolation uint out_flags : TEXCOORD1;
    float2 out_uv : TEXCOORD2;
    float4 gl_Position : SV_Position;
};

void main_inner()
{
    Sprite _25;
    _25.position = asfloat(_17.Load2(gl_InstanceIndex * 48 + 0));
    _25.size = asfloat(_17.Load2(gl_InstanceIndex * 48 + 8));
    _25.color = asfloat(_17.Load4(gl_InstanceIndex * 48 + 16));
    _25.flags = _17.Load(gl_InstanceIndex * 48 + 32);
    _25.rotation = asfloat(_17.Load(gl_InstanceIndex * 48 + 36));
    Sprite s;
    s.position = _25.position;
    s.size = _25.size;
    s.color = _25.color;
    s.flags = _25.flags;
    s.rotation = _25.rotation;
    float2 corner = camera_corners[gl_VertexIndex % 4].xy;
    float c = cos(s.rotation);
    float n = sin(s.rotation);
    float2 p = (float2((corner.x * c) - (corner.y * n), (corner.x * n) + (corner.y * c)) * s.size) + s.position;
    float h = heightmap.SampleLevel(_heightmap_sampler, p * 0.00999999977648258209228515625f, 0.0f).x;
    if (camera_mode == 1)
    {
        h *= 2.0f;
    }
    else
    {
        if (camera_mode > 1)
        {
            h = -h;
        }
    }
    out_color = s.color;
    out_flags = s.flags | uint(gl_VertexIndex << 16);
    out_uv = (corner * 0.5f) + 0.5f.xx;
    gl_Position = mul(float4(p, h, 1.0f), camera_view_projection);
    gl_PointSize = 1.0f;
}

SPIRV_Cross_Output main(SPIRV_Cross_Input stage_input)
{
    gl_VertexIndex = int(stage_input.gl_VertexIndex);
    gl_InstanceIndex = int(stage_input.gl_InstanceIndex);
    main_inner();
    SPIRV_Cross_Output stage_output;
    stage_output.gl_Position = gl_Position;
    stage_output.out_color = out_color;
    stage_output.out_flags = out_flags;
    stage_output.out_uv = out_uv;
    return stage_output;
}

    _25.color = asfloat(_17.Load4(gl_InstanceIndex * 48 + 16));
    _25.flags = _17.Load(gl_InstanceIndex * 48 + 32);
    _25.rotation = asfloat(_17.Load(gl_InstanceIndex * 48 + 36));
    Sprite s;
    s.position = _25.position;
    s.size = _25.size;
    s.color = _25.color;
    s.flags = _25.flags;
    s.rotation = _25.rotation;
    float2 corner = camera_corners[gl_VertexIndex % 4].xy;
    float c = cos(s.rotation);
    float n = sin(s.rotation);
    float2 p = (float2((corner.x * c) - (corner.y * n), (corner.x * n) + (corner.y * c)) * s.size) + s.position;
    float h = heightmap.SampleLevel(_heightmap_sampler, p * 0.00999999977648258209228515625f, 0.0f).x;
    if (camera_mode == 1)
    {
        h *= 2.0f;
    }
    else
    {
        if (camera_mode > 1)
        {
            h = -h;
        }
    }
    out_color = s.color;
    out_flags = s.flags | uint(gl_VertexIndex << 16);
    out_uv = (corner * 0.5f) + 0.5f.xx;
    gl_Position = mul(float4(p, h, 1.0f), camera_view_projection);
    gl_PointSize = 1.0f;
}

SPIRV_Cross_Output main(SPIRV_Cross_Input stage_input)
{
    gl_VertexIndex = int(stage_input.gl_VertexIndex);
    gl_InstanceIndex = int(stage_input.gl_InstanceIndex);

}

struct Sprite
{
    float2 position;
    float2 size;
    float4 color;
    uint flags;
    float rotation;
};

ByteAddressBuffer _17 : register(t1);
cbuffer Camera : register(b0)
{
    row_major float4x4 camera_view_projection : packoffset(c0);
    float4 camera_corners[4] : packoffset(c4);
    int camera_mode : packoffset(c8);
};

Texture2D<float4> heightmap : register(t0);
SamplerState _heightmap_sampler : register(s0);

static float4 gl_Position;
static float gl_PointSize;
static int gl_VertexIndex;
static int gl_InstanceIndex;
static float4 out_color;
static uint out_flags;
static float2 out_uv;

struct SPIRV_Cross_Input
{
    uint gl_VertexIndex : SV_VertexID;
    uint gl_InstanceIndex : SV_InstanceID;
};

struct SPIRV_Cross_Output
{
    float4 out_color : TEXCOORD0;
    nointerpolation uint out_flags : TEXCOORD1;
    float2 out_uv : TEXCOORD2;
    float4 gl_Position : SV_Position;
};

void vert_main()
{
    Sprite _25;
    _25.position = asfloat(_17.Load2(gl_InstanceIndex * 48 + 0));
    _25.size = asfloat(_17.Load2(gl_InstanceIndex * 48 + 8));
    _25.color = asfloat(_17.Load4(gl_InstanceIndex * 48 + 16));
    _25.flags = _17.Load(gl_InstanceIndex * 48 + 32);
    _25.rotation = asfloat(_17.Load(gl_InstanceIndex * 48 + 36));
    Sprite s;
    s.position = _25.position;
    s.size = _25.size;
    s.color = _25.color;
    s.flags = _25.flags;
    s.rotation = _25.rotation;
    float2 corner = camera_corners[gl_VertexIndex % 4].xy;
    float c = cos(s.rotation);
    float n = sin(s.rotation);
    float2 p = (float2((corner.x * c) - (corner.y * n), (corner.x * n) + (corner.y * c)) * s.size) + s.position;
    float h = heightmap.SampleLevel(_heightmap_sampler, p * 0.00999999977648258209228515625f, 0.0f).x;
    if (camera_mode == 1)
    {
        h *= 2.0f;
    }
    else
    {
        if (camera_mode > 1)
        {
            h = -h;
        }
    }
    out_color = s.color;
    out_flags = s.flags | uint(gl_VertexIndex << 16);
    out_uv = (corner * 0.5f) + 0.5f.xx;
    gl_Position = mul(float4(p, h, 1.0f), camera_view_projection);
    gl_PointSize = 1.0f;
}

SPIRV_Cross_Output main(SPIRV_Cross_Input stage_input)
{
    gl_VertexIndex = int(stage_input.gl_VertexIndex);
    gl_InstanceIndex = int(stage_input.gl_InstanceIndex);
    vert_main();
    SPIRV_Cross_Output stage_output;
    stage_output.gl_Position = gl_Position;
    stage_output.out_color = out_color;
    stage_output.out_flags = out_flags;
    stage_output.out_uv = out_uv;
